name: SSH signature
responsibility: Build and armor SSHSIG signatures from a hardware ECDSA signature.
description: Parses the -Y sign options that git and jj pass. Routing compares the -f key with key.pub, which init wrote, and never reads the key file, so an unusable machine key never blocks another key. A -f key that is not the machine key, including a private key file, goes to ssh-keygen unchanged, so per-repository signing keys keep working. For the machine key, it tries the preferred key first, then builds the SSHSIG with the ssh-key crate (namespace, sha512 message hash) and has the hardware sign the SHA-256 digest of the signed data.
